subject: PraxisHealth CAIQ — scope segmentation, evidence consolidation & delivery plan
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood-inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-08-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PraxisHealth CAIQ — internal split & deliverable plan

Marissa / Jonas,

Following the intake call with Praxis yesterday, they sent over the CAIQ matrix (attached). They want a single consolidated package but also asked that runtime evidence for their EU workload be separated (data residency / tenant segmentation). To avoid rework, propose we: 

- Create two bundles: "Core Controls" (global controls applicable to all tenants) and "EU-resident Runtime" (evidence tied to EU-region handling).
- Tag every artifact in redwood-evidence-index.csv with control id, owner, and scope (global|eu).
- Ship the CAIQ answers PDF + evidence bundle to Praxis by EOD Friday (8/13).

Can Jonas take lead on the EU runtime separation? Marissa, can you own the consolidated CAIQ answer PDF and the DocuSign/Drive handoff? I’ll coordinate with Legal on any redaction needs.

Attachments: Praxis_CAIQ_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx, redwood-evidence-index.csv

Action items:
- Jonas: break out runtime artifacts and confirm any non-exportable logs (by 8/12 11:00 PT)
- Marissa: finalize answer draft and prepare Drive upload link (by 8/12 16:00 PT)
- Evelyn: confirm redaction checklist with Legal (ETA 8/12 12:00 PT)

Thanks —
Evelyn Hart
Sr. Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Emma Bryant <emma.bryant@praxishealth.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood-inference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-08-11T10:33:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: PraxisHealth CAIQ — internal split & deliverable plan

Hi Emma —

Forwarding our internal plan so you have visibility on how we'll package the CAIQ responses. Summary below: 

- We'll provide one consolidated CAIQ answer PDF plus two evidence bundles: Global Controls and EU Runtime Evidence.
- Target delivery: EOD Friday, 8/13.
- Drive link for uploads will be sent once we confirm the final bundle.

Quick questions for you to confirm scope: 
1) Confirm which Praxis tenants must be treated as EU-resident (names or tenant IDs OK).
2) Any specific controls you want timeboxed (e.g., if you only need crypto/key rotation evidence for production)?

If that timeline works, we’ll proceed. Attached is our answer draft (CAIQ-answer-draft.pdf) — consider it an internal working draft; final will have attestations.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Strategic Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-08-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PraxisHealth CAIQ — internal split & deliverable plan
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood-inference.com>

(see above)

From: Emma Bryant <emma.bryant@praxishealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: security@praxishealth.com
Date: 2027-08-11T14:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PraxisHealth CAIQ — scope segmentation, evidence consolidation & delivery plan

Marissa —

Thanks for the plan and for sharing the draft. Timeline looks fine; we can take the consolidated package on 8/13. A few clarifying items from our security team before you finalize: 

- EU-resident tenants: tenant-eu-prod-01 and tenant-eu-dev-02. Please ensure any logs or telemetry for tenant-eu-prod-01 are exported with EU-only residency evidence.
- Controls we need focused functional evidence for (not just narrative): CCM-03 (Key Management), CCM-07 (Runtime Isolation), CCM-11 (Telemetry & Monitoring). For CCM-07, a diagram of the inference tenancy (KV cache segregation, GPU pool assignment) + a short runbook showing how a tenant is isolated during autoscaling would be helpful.
- For CCM-11, if you can include a 24-hour sample slice from your runtime telemetry (anonymized), that will speed review. If the sample contains PII, we need a sanitized process description instead.

Also, please provide a preferred upload method: secure Share or our SFTP? We prefer the Drive link you mentioned (with restricted access) or the secure Share portal.

Emma Bryant
Director, Security Engineering
PraxisHealth

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood-inference.com>
To: Emma Bryant <emma.bryant@praxishealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-08-12T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PraxisHealth CAIQ — scope segmentation, evidence consolidation & delivery plan

Emma / team —

Appreciate the quick clarifications. Answers & next steps below: 

1) EU tenant separation: confirmed — we'll isolate artifacts for tenant-eu-prod-01 and tenant-eu-dev-02. The runtime bundle will include:
   - network_and_tenant_topology_v1.png (diagram showing KV cache routing and GPU assignment)
   - autoscale-isolation-runbook.pdf (step-by-step for tenant isolation during scale events)

2) Key Management (CCM-03): we will include the KMS rotation policy excerpt, attestation from our infra team, and a redacted rotation log demonstrating a rotation event (redaction applied per Legal checklist).

3) Telemetry sample (CCM-11): we can provide a 24-hour slice with identifiers hashed. If Praxis prefers no hashed identifiers, we will instead provide the telemetry extraction pipeline doc + sample schema. Attached is runtime-telemetry-samples.zip (contains masked samples and extraction manifest).

Upload & access: we created a restricted Drive folder and will invite security@praxishealth.com. Link: https://drive.redwood-inference.com/drive/folders/1a2B-praxis-caiq (shared with view-only + download disabled by default; we can open download on request).

We plan to publish the final CAIQ answer PDF + the two evidence bundles to that folder by 8/13 15:00 PT. If Praxis wants a DocuSign attestation afterward, Marissa will coordinate.

Next step: 30-min sync tomorrow 8/13 09:00 PT to walk through the EU runtime artifacts. Can you confirm?

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Senior Security Engineer, Evidence & Instrumentation
Redwood Inference

Attachments: runtime-telemetry-samples.zip, network_and_tenant_topology_v1.png, autoscale-isolation-runbook.pdf
